```{r setup, include=FALSE}
x <- params$result
```

## Design and results

```{r results, echo=FALSE}
print(x)
if (!is.null(x$data$native) && length(setdiff(names(x$data), c("native", "design"))))
  print(x$data$native)
```

## Statistical specification

```{r assumptions, echo=FALSE}
print(x$specification)
```

## Methodological provenance

```{r provenance, echo=FALSE}
print(x$provenance)
```

Monte Carlo estimates include Monte Carlo standard errors and exact 95%
binomial confidence intervals. Analytical outputs are labeled separately.
Computational execution alone does not establish scientific validation.
